answer.reason: Both galvanize steel and act as intermediate metal processors, so the offering overlaps. AZZ is mainly a hot-dip galvanizer of customer-fabricated steel for infrastructure and a coil coater. Worthington Steel buys coil and processes it (pickling, slitting, blanking, galvanizing, laminations, tailor welded blanks) for automotive, appliance and construction customers. Customers and end markets overlap only in part (appliance, construction), and the automotive-driven steel processing model differs. Overlap is real but not on both product and customers.

primary_services.reason: Both offer galvanizing; AZZ adds coil coating and surface technologies, while Worthington adds pickling, slitting, blanking and laminations.

end_markets.reason: AZZ leans toward infrastructure and construction. Worthington leans toward automotive, with appliance and construction also served. The overlap is partial.

business_model.reason: Both are processors that add value to steel. AZZ coats steel supplied by customers, while Worthington is an intermediate processor of carbon flat-rolled steel.

value_chain_position.reason: Both sit in the middle of the metal chain as processors or coaters, serving different downstream users.

T:P2.1.text: North America's Leading Metal Coatings Company - About AZZ

T:P2.2.text: Learn about AZZ, North America's leading metal coatings company, delivering galvanizing, coil coating, and advanced metal coating solutions.

T:P2.3.text: Industry-leading provider of metal coating solutions supporting everyday life

T:P2.4.text: AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.

T:P2.5.text: Meeting the needs of diverse and evolving markets

T:P2.6.text: AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.

T:P2.7.text: North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer of fabricated steel

T:P2.8.text: AZZ Galvanizing provides industry-leading corrosion protection solutions that help extend service life, reduce maintenance requirements, and improve lifecycle performance across critical infrastructure and fabricated steel applications. As North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer, AZZ combines scalable capacity, decades of galvanizing expertise, and a commitment to consistent quality and responsive customer support.

T:P2.9.text: North America’s leading independent provider of coil coating services

C:S1.1.text: Its galvanized line includes hot-dipped galvanized steel and galvanneal, which the company says is commonly used in automotive, appliance, and construction applications.

C:S2.1.text: As an intermediate processor of carbon flat-rolled steel, Worthington Steel offers a range of value-added services including pickling, galvanizing, slitting, blanking, and specialty re-rolling. It also makes electrical steel laminations and tailor welded blanks.

C:S3.1.text: The company says it supports Tier I, II, and III automotive programs. Its tailor welded blanks serve automotive lightweighting.
